purpose: Add an epistemic annotation layer to the human-reviewed PVS-16 ClaimIR without changing ClaimIR structure or Grammar-v0 mapping.
evidence_level_basis: claim-to-frozen-source warrant directness, not journal prestige, truth probability, source quality, or overall scientific importance

E0.label: MODEL_SYNTHESIS_OR_PROPOSAL
E0.rule: The relation is proposed, defined, synthesized, or model-specified, but the frozen evidence packet does not expose a direct empirical test of that exact relation.

E1.label: DIRECT_NONINTERVENTIONAL
E1.rule: The frozen evidence packet directly reports observation, comparison, retention, covariance/correlation, or model-mediated empirical association, without direct manipulation of the relation-defining variable.

E2.label: DIRECT_INTERVENTIONAL
E2.rule: The frozen evidence packet directly reports an experimental intervention, perturbation, or manipulation of the relation-defining variable with a corresponding outcome.

E3.label: EXPLICIT_REPLICATED_INTERVENTIONAL
E3.rule: E2 criteria are met and the frozen evidence packet explicitly states confirmation across multiple experiments, tasks, or comparable intervention contexts for the same relation.

aggregation.claim_level: Do not collapse to one score. Report the minimum and maximum relation-level evidence levels present in the claim.

interpretation_constraints: E0 does not mean false or low-quality; it means the frozen packet does not expose a direct empirical test of the exact relation.
E3 is not a universal quality ranking over E2; it adds explicit cross-context replication breadth.
Source visibility (abstract-only versus full text) is recorded separately and does not change evidence level.
Evidence profiles must not alter ClaimIR, structural adjudication, bounded Archetype/XLike identities, or Grammar-v0 mappings.
